## ⚠️ 꼭 반영할 것
- 장소는 **고양 KINTEX**. "Seoul downtown"/"서울 시내" 금지.
- 공식 페이지 문구가 오늘 **"3 full action packed days"** 로 확인됨 → 3일(금 13·토 14·일 15).
- 웨이브는 **provisional / subject to change**. 공식: 개인 스타트 시간은 **대회 약 3일 전에 링크 공개**, **스타트 시간 변경 불가**.
- 일요일 릴레이는 11/7 변경분 유지(Men 17:50–18:30, Women 20:20–20:30). 1106 초안 숫자 쓰지 말 것.
- **Flex 50% 환불 언급 금지**(창 이미 닫힘). 지금 가능한 건 Lite Flex/Flex의 **이름 변경 1회, 레이스 전날 07:59(현지)까지**. 같은 성별로만 교체. 이벤트 이전 불가.
- 참가비·관람 티켓 가격 숫자 금지(공식 본문에 없음). 전화번호·이메일 금지. "MZ 사우나", 효능 단정 금지.
- 시상식(Ceremony) 시간표는 공식 페이지 금요일 블록이 다른 날 항목과 섞여 있어 혼동 소지 → 쓰지 말 것.

## 그대로 써도 되는 사실 (영어)
출처: https://hyrox.com/event/hyrox-seoul/ (오늘 재조회)

1. **Event**: AirAsia HYROX Seoul · **Fri Nov 13 – Sun Nov 15, 2026** · KINTEX, Goyang (217-60 Kintex-ro, Ilsanseo-gu, Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do). 8 × 1 km run + 8 workout stations. Open/Pro, Doubles/Doubles Pro, Relay.
2. **Start times**: provisional schedule now; individual start times linked ~3 days before the event. Start time changes are not permitted.
3. **Wave schedule (subject to change)**
   - **Fri 13**: 08:30–11:20 Men Open (incl. Adaptive) · 11:50–14:50 Doubles Men Open · 15:20–16:30 Doubles Women Open · 16:40–17:10 Women Open (incl. Adaptive) · 17:50–20:20 Doubles Mixed
   - **Sat 14**: 08:30–12:40 Men Open (incl. Adaptive) · 13:10–13:30 Doubles Women Pro · 13:40–14:00 Women Pro · 14:30–17:40 Doubles Mixed · 18:20–19:20 Doubles Men Pro · 19:30–20:20 Men Pro
   - **Sun 15**: 08:30–11:00 Doubles Women Open · 11:10–12:30 Women Open (incl. Adaptive) · 13:10–17:20 Doubles Men Open · 17:50–18:30 Relay Men · 19:00–19:50 Relay Mixed · 20:20–20:30 Relay Women
4. **Early athlete registration (Friday racers only)**: **Thu Nov 12, 11:00–19:00**, EPIC SEOUL 5F, The Hyundai Seoul, 108 Yeouidae-ro, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul. Friday Men Open / Doubles Men Open / Women Open / Doubles Mixed. No spectator check-in. Bring ID; no checking in for others.
5. **Race-day registration at KINTEX** (registration closes 20:00 each day)
   - **Fri 13**: 07:30 Men Open · 09:00 Doubles Men Open · 13:30 Doubles Women Open & Women Open · 16:00 Doubles Mixed · 17:00 **Saturday** Men Open
   - **Sat 14**: 07:30 Men Open · 12:00 Doubles Women Pro, Women Pro, Doubles Mixed · 17:00 Doubles Men Pro & Men Pro · 18:00 **Sunday** Doubles Women Open
   - **Sun 15**: 07:30 Doubles Women Open · 09:00 Women Open · 12:00 Doubles Men Open · 16:00 Relay Men · 17:00 Relay Mixed · 18:00 Relay Women
   - (Saturday Men Open can register Fri 17:00; Sunday Doubles Women Open can register Sat 18:00.)
   - Adaptive athletes: check in at the help desk (pre-registration or race day).
6. **Wristband**: venue access only on your race day. To enter before your check-in window, go via Spectators check-in with your athlete ticket QR (race day only). Other days need a spectator ticket.
7. **Course tip (official)**: Singles/Doubles/Relay — "Go IN the SECOND time you see the 'IN'."
8. **Name change**: Lite Flex / Flex — 1 name change until 07:59 AM (Seoul time) one day before your race; substitute must be same gender. No Flex = no changes. (Refund windows: do not mention.)
9. **Parking** (unchanged from 11/8 packet): ₩3,720/hour · ₩19,000 all-day; 5+ hours → all-day better.
10. **Photos**: Sportograf, about 48 hours after your race on sportograf.com (selfie search).
